title: Directory-based access for OpenSharing SecureConnect (Public Preview)
body: OpenSharing SecureConnect can now deliver eligible tables and views to Databricks recipients using serverless compute with directory-based access instead of per-file pre-signed URLs, for better performance. This feature is in [Public Preview](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). Account admins can manage the **OpenSharing SecureConnect Directory Based Access** preview from the account console **Previews** page. See [Directory-based access for SecureConnect](/aws/en/opensharing/secureconnect-provider#directory-based-access).
